comment: Read-only host data the dispatcher advertises to lane children. Entries whose path is absent on the host are dropped from the task packet with a note, so the same manifest is harmless on another machine. Nothing listed here may ever be written by a lane.

binance_um_1m_klines_10pairs.description: PRIMARY market data. 10 Binance USDM pairs (BTC ETH BNB XRP ADA DOGE DOT LINK LTC SOL), 1m klines as monthly zips with .CHECKSUM files, 2020-01..2026-08. Later listings start later (DOGE 2020-07, DOT 2020-08, SOL 2020-09). Verified: a monthly zip holds exactly the minutes of that month.

binance_um_funding_rates_10pairs.description: Funding-rate history for the same 10 pairs, monthly.

cb16_raw_download_manifest.description: Provenance for the raw collection: symbols, range, per-segment counts and coverage. Read this before assuming coverage.

frozen_weights_r10_lineage.description: PRIMARY frozen weights, extracted read-only from the R10/R11 archives: central_brain_g0.pt, central_brain_g0_r10_parent.pt, CANONICAL_NONLINEAR48_SEED24680_PORTABLE.npz, operator_reducers_v1{,_PORTABLE}.npz, the frozen sensory canary and the account-physics simulator snapshot. SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.txt records the source archive hashes.

e4_t1_curated_1m_5m_1h.description: Curated 1m/5m/1h dataset with manifest, split protocol and SHA256SUMS. raw_1m/ holds per-symbol csv.gz.

binance_usdm_1m_raw_vault.description: Raw Binance USDM 1m collection vault: work/source/<year> plus yearly bundle tarballs in output/. (superseded by binance_um_1m_klines_10pairs)

frozen_body_archives.description: Frozen body archives (CB16_SHANXI_FROZEN_BODY_*.tar.gz) and R10 return bundles. Treat as immutable inputs. (source archives; extracted copies live in /cb16/frozen)
